description: Place a signature (or initials, stamp, logo) image on PDF pages at x/y/width in points, measured from the top-left of the page as it is shown (rotated pages are handled). A light paper background is removed by default so scanned signatures sit cleanly on the page. Optional text marks (name, date…) can be added too. This is a visual signature, not a cryptographic digital signature. To draw a signature by hand, use the web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/pdf-sign/

file.description: The PDF: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

height.description: Height in points. Default: keeps the image aspect ratio.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

removeBackground.description: Make light (paper) pixels transparent and trim to the ink. Default true.

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

signature.description: Signature image: local path or base64 (PNG, JPEG, WebP…).

texts.description: Optional text marks, e.g. the printed name or the date.

y.description: Top edge in points from the top of the page.

threshold.description: Brightness (0-255) above which pixels become transparent. Default 210.

x.description: Left edge in points from the left of the page (72 pt = 1 inch). Default 72.

y.description: Top edge in points from the TOP of the page. Default: 72 pt above the bottom margin.

name: pdf_sign_image
title: Sign PDF with an image
